name: Outreach
tagline: Outreach is a leading sales execution platform that orchestrates multi-channel sequences — email, phone, LinkedIn, SMS — and analyses which approaches convert best for each prospect segment. Its AI Kaia assistant surfaces objection-handling playbooks in real time during live calls, and a deal health score highlights the accounts most at risk. Enterprise sales organisations use Outreach to run disciplined, data-driven revenue motions.
